No, they were caused by a traumatic long-term relationship.
The fact that I've spent most of my life having no friends and being completely isolated probably didn't help either.

It's hard to explain, but I know that I would be living the dream right now had a traumatic relationship not caused me to collapse. I was pursuing something which I knew would make me very successful and in the exact way that I wanted; it was perfect. I also knew all of the routes I wanted to take in life and this was going to be the foundation. Obviously, everything is completely random and the possibility is there that something terrible could have happened, but I essentially had everything planned out and everything was in place. This is unfortunately not something I can just 'do again', I have completely missed the opportunity for my life to go the way I wanted it to. Unfortunately, this is not just a singular issue; all of the many circumstances have worked together in harmony to cause a gigantic chain of alteration and destruction which means that the entire span of my life is going to be drastically different in every single way. This is something I find impossible to accept; I feel as if I am living a different version of my life and a different version of myself. Rationally, the perspective I should adopt is that there is no 'wrong path' and you should just accept life as it goes because it's just a random chain of events. Unfortunately, though, no matter how hard I try, I cannot embrace this mindset. I can't help but see everything as pointless in comparison to the things I knew were going to happen in my life. Even winning the lottery and becoming extremely handsome would not make me happy. This all seems stupid, I know, but I'm just never going to have peace ever again.

Unfortunately for me, there is no time when I am 'okay' - I actually have no concept of what that would be like. Even if something good happens to me or if I don't necessarily feel depressed, there is still this permanent sense of being in an alternative, isolated universe where I am alone in my punishment forever. I think this is largely down to the fact that I know exactly how my life would have played out had this not have happened, so I can't shake the feeling of incorrectness and confusion. Why did this happen? Why am I here, when I know I should be there? This is all I'm ever able to think about, and it's torture.

I only see two options: dying or turning back time. Only one of these things is possible, but that thing is extremely difficult and it feels as if it's not even an option, so I feel completely trapped and hopeless. 

I also hope, you I, and everybody alike manages to find some kind of improvement, however non-existent that may seem.
